codeReview.summary: Implementation is complete and correct. Part A: All 4 non-plan workflow definitions updated with task-adaptive validationCriteria — research (3 steps rewritten to remove hardcoded patterns), review (2 steps permit zero-findings), ship (1 step permits no-learnings), debug (1 step removes file:line mandate). Plan workflow correctly left unchanged. Part B: task_context field added as optional to EvaluatorInputSchema (backward compatible), threaded through EvaluateOptions → Evaluator.evaluate() → invokeWithTimeout() → EvaluatorInput. SubprocessEvaluatorTransport.buildPrompt() renders '## Task Context' section before '## Worker Output' when present, omits it when absent. Execution loop populates taskContext from phase.description || phase.title || '' and converts empty string to undefined. Both initial evaluation and revision loop evaluations pass taskContext. 18 tests cover all 10 VAL-ALIGN assertions. The diff is clean with 9 files changed, ~453 insertions, ~14 deletions.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The taskContext fallback chain (phase.description || phase.title || '') means empty descriptions with non-empty titles will use the title. This fallback behavior is implicit and not documented. If future phases have neither description nor title, the evaluator receives no task context (undefined), which is fine but worth noting as a convention for anyone adding new workflow phases.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/controller/execution-loop.ts:523 — const taskContext = phase.description || phase.title || ""; followed by taskContext: taskContext || undefined
